correctness.rationale: Coordinate determinant enumerates the 12 affine-line forbidden triples and all 171 nonempty faces with f=(9,36,72,54). The explicit increasing-vertex toggle algorithm yields 79 Hasse pairs and critical masks 1,54,70,216,232,240,344,360,368,390,408,424,432, with cell dimensions (0 once,2 once,3 eleven). Reconstructed every one of 504 directed Hasse edges and verified DAG acyclicity, so Forman gives a CW with those cells. Independently computed signed rational rank 43 of 72x54 simplicial boundary ∂3; hence H3(Q)=11. The Morse CW degree-3 differential Z^11->Z must vanish over Q and therefore integrally. Because π2(S2)=Z detected by degree, each 3-cell attachment vanishes, proving the integral wedge homotopy type. Finite checks are exhaustive for this fixed object, not extrapolations.
